values.name: eSCM_Replace
values.description: Clear existing stat changes (`m_aStatChanges`) before applying yours. (Default)

values.name: eSCM_Merge
values.description: Update the entry for each `StatType` if present, otherwise add it.

values.name: eAES_Target
values.description: Edit `AbilityTargetEffects` (effects applied to the primary target). (Default)

values.name: eAES_MultiTarget
values.description: Edit `AbilityMultiTargetEffects`.

values.name: eAES_Shooter
values.description: Edit `AbilityShooterEffects` (effects applied to the shooter).

values.name: eCBM_Replace
values.description: Clear existing `BonusCharges` entries before applying yours. (Default)

values.name: eCBM_Merge
values.description: Update the entry for each `AbilityName` if present, otherwise add it.

values.name: eACEM_Replace
values.description: Clear existing `AditionalAbilityCooldowns` entries before applying yours. (Default)

values.name: eACEM_Merge
values.description: Update the entry for each `AbilityName` if present, otherwise add it.

values.name: eACEM_ReplaceAll
values.description: As `CostMode`: clear **all** existing costs before applying the entries. As per-entry `Mode`: edit in place if a cost of that class exists, otherwise skip (unless `CostMode=eACEM_ReplaceAll`, in which case a new cost is added). (Default)

values.name: eACEM_Merge
values.description: Edit the existing cost of that class in place; if none exists, instantiate and add it.

values.name: eACEM_AddOnly
values.description: Same as `eACEM_Merge`: edit in place if present, otherwise add.

values.name: eACEM_Remove
values.description: Remove the cost of that class from the ability.

values.name: eAEM_ReplaceAll
values.description: Clear the whole target array, then add this effect/condition. (Default)

values.name: eAEM_Merge
values.description: Edit the existing effect/condition of that class in place; if none exists, instantiate and add it.

values.name: eAEM_AddOnly
values.description: Same as `eAEM_Merge`: edit in place if present, otherwise add.

values.name: eAEM_Remove
values.description: Remove the first effect/condition of that class from the target array.

values.name: eNAEM_Replace
values.description: Replace the whole target array with the provided values. (Default)

values.name: eNAEM_Merge
values.description: Append each provided value that is not already present.

values.name: eNAEM_AddOnly
values.description: Set the provided values **only if the target array is currently empty**; otherwise do nothing. It does not append.

values.name: eNAEM_Remove
values.description: Remove each provided value from the target array.

values.name: eACP_Standard
values.description: `TypicalAbility_BuildGameState`, `TypicalAbility_BuildVisualization` and `TypicalAbility_BuildInterruptGameState`: a normal activated ability such as a shot, a grenade or a protocol. The entry must still provide `TargetStyle`, `ToHitCalc` and `Triggers`. (Default)

values.name: eACP_MoveEnd
values.description: As Standard, but the game state is built by `TypicalMoveEndAbility_BuildGameState`: a move-then-act ability such as Slash. Expects an `X2AbilityTarget_MovingMelee` target style.

values.name: eACP_Passive
values.description: `TypicalAbility_BuildGameState` only, no visualization, `bIsPassive=true`, neutral hostility, icon hidden in the HUD. Installs `X2AbilityTarget_Self`, `X2AbilityTrigger_UnitPostBeginPlay` and `X2AbilityToHitCalc_DeadEye`, so the entry only has to add the persistent effect.

fields.name: AbilityName
fields.description: Ability whose cooldown entry is added/updated in `AditionalAbilityCooldowns`.

fields.name: NumTurns
fields.description: Cooldown applied to that other ability, in turns.

fields.name: ApplyCooldownType
fields.description: `AdditionalCooldown_ApplyLarger` or `AdditionalCooldown_ApplySmaller`. Applied when non-empty.

fields.name: AbilityName
fields.description: Ability that grants the bonus charges.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Cost class to target/instantiate, e.g. `X2AbilityCost_ActionPoints`. Bare names are auto-prefixed with `XComGame.`; empty falls back to `X2AbilityCost`.

fields.name: Mode
fields.description: Per-entry edit mode (`EAbilityCostEditMode`). Defaults to the enum's first value, which clears the existing list.

fields.name: FreeCost
fields.description: Makes the ability cost nothing. The ability must satisfy the requirement to be usable, but using it doesn't consume action point.

fields.name: NumPoints
fields.description: Action points the ability consumes.

fields.name: AddWeaponTypicalCost
fields.description: Adds the weapon's own typical action cost on top of NumPoints.

fields.name: ConsumeAllPoints
fields.description: Ends the turn by consuming every remaining action point, rather than just NumPoints.

fields.name: MoveCost
fields.description: Treats the cost as movement, so effects and abilities that key off moving apply.

fields.name: AllowedTypes
fields.description: Action point types that may pay this cost. Restricting it stops the ability being paid for with, say, a Run-and-Gun point.

fields.name: DoNotConsumeAllEffects
fields.description: If the user is under any of these effects, ConsumeAllPoints is ignored and the turn does not end.

fields.name: DoNotConsumeAllSoldierAbilities
fields.description: If the user has any of these abilities, ConsumeAllPoints is ignored. This is how Blademaster lets Slash keep the turn going.

fields.name: SharedAbilityCharges
fields.description: Other abilities whose charges are spent alongside this one, as Skulljack and Skullmine share a pool. Applied when paying, never when checking affordability.

fields.name: FocusAmount
fields.description: Templar focus consumed.

fields.name: ConsumeAllFocus
fields.description: Spends the user's entire focus pool rather than FocusAmount.

fields.name: GhostOnlyCost
fields.description: Only charges focus to a Ghost, leaving the original Templar's pool untouched.

fields.name: NumAmmo
fields.description: Ammo consumed per use. With ConsumeAllAmmo set this becomes the minimum needed to fire, rather than the amount spent.

fields.name: UseLoadedAmmo
fields.description: Draws from the loaded grenade rather than the weapon's ammo, for grenade-launcher abilities.

fields.name: ReturnChargesError
fields.description: Reports a shortfall as "out of charges" instead of "out of ammo", for abilities presented to the player as charge-based.

fields.name: ConsumeAllAmmo
fields.description: Spends the whole magazine. NumAmmo then only sets the minimum required to fire.

fields.name: NumCharges
fields.description: Charges consumed per use.

fields.name: OnlyOnHit
fields.description: Only spends the charge when the ability hits, so a miss costs nothing.

fields.name: AlsoExpendChargesOnSharedBondmateAbility
fields.description: Also spends the bondmate's charges of the shared ability.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Optional. Omitted = edit the existing cooldown in place. Set = target/instantiate that class, e.g. `X2AbilityCooldown_PerPlayerType`. Bare names are auto-prefixed with `XComGame.`.

fields.name: NumTurns
fields.description: Turns the ability is unavailable after use.

fields.name: IgnoreOnHit
fields.description: Skips applying the cooldown when the ability hits, so only a miss puts it on cooldown.

fields.name: AdditionalCooldowns
fields.description: Cooldowns this ability also puts on *other* abilities, keyed by AbilityName. Used where firing one thing should lock out another.

fields.name: NumTurnsForAI
fields.description: Cooldown used when the unit is AI-controlled, letting XCOM and the enemy run different timings. Only on X2AbilityCooldown_PerPlayerType.

fields.name: NumGlobalTurns
fields.description: Cooldown applied across every unit on the team, not just the one that used the ability. Only on the global cooldown classes.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Optional. Omitted = edit the existing charges object in place. Set = target/instantiate that class, e.g. `X2AbilityCharges_GremlinHeal`. Bare names are auto-prefixed with `XComGame.`.

fields.name: InitialCharges
fields.description: Charges the ability starts a mission with.

fields.name: BonusCharges
fields.description: Extra charges granted when the unit has another ability, keyed by AbilityName. This is how Restoration adds charges to the medikit heal.

fields.name: RemoveCharges
fields.description: Set to true to remove the ability's charges object entirely. No `Class` needed; the other fields of the block are ignored.

fields.name: Stabilize
fields.description: Whether the charges behave as the stabilise-style pool, on the charge classes that support it.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Condition class to target/instantiate, e.g. `X2Condition_UnitProperty`. Bare names are auto-prefixed with `XComGame.`.

fields.name: Mode
fields.description: Per-entry edit mode (`EArrayEditMode`). Defaults to the enum's first value, which clears the existing array.

fields.name: OwnerHasSoldierAbilitiesMode
fields.description: X2Condition_AbilityProperty

fields.name: OwnerHasSoldierAbilities
fields.description: Soldier abilities the unit owning the ability must have.

fields.name: TargetMustBeInValidTiles
fields.description: Reject targets standing outside the ability's valid tiles.

fields.name: WantsReload
fields.description: Fail with AA_AmmoAlreadyFull when the source weapon's clip is already full.

fields.name: CheckAmmo
fields.description: Compare the source weapon's ammo against CheckAmmoData.

fields.name: CheckAmmoData
fields.description: The ammo check used when CheckAmmo is true: Value, CheckType, and ValueMin/ValueMax for range checks.

fields.name: NotLoadedAmmoInSecondaryWeapon
fields.description: Fail when the source weapon is currently loaded as ammo in the secondary weapon.

fields.name: MatchGrenadeType
fields.description: Grenade template the source weapon, or its loaded ammo, must be.

fields.name: CheckGrenadeFriendlyFire
fields.description: Reject friendly targets unless the grenade template allows friendly fire.

fields.name: CheckAmmoTechLevel
fields.description: Reject the source ammo when it is not valid for the unit's primary weapon.

fields.name: MatchWeaponTemplate
fields.description: Weapon template the source weapon must be, exact match on its DataName.

fields.name: StilettoRounds
fields.description: Pass only while the Stiletto Rounds dark event is active.

fields.name: RequiredGameplayTag
fields.description: Tactical gameplay tag XCOM HQ must carry for the ability to be valid.

fields.name: DisallowGameplayTag
fields.description: Tactical gameplay tag that makes the ability invalid while XCOM HQ carries it.

fields.name: HourChecksMode
fields.description: X2Condition_GameTime

fields.name: HourChecks
fields.description: Checks against the current hour of the day; the condition passes when any one of them does. Merge adds checks not already present.

fields.name: NumTurnsCheck
fields.description: Check against the number of turns the target's controlling player has taken.

fields.name: ActionPointChecksMode
fields.description: X2Condition_UnitActionPoints (merged by ActionPointType)

fields.name: ActionPointChecks
fields.description: Action point checks; passes when any one of them does. Each names an action point type, whether to count reserved points, and the value check.

fields.name: RequiredAlertStatusMaximum
fields.description: Highest alert level the unit may have. -1 ignores it; the condition fails when both limits are -1.

fields.name: RequiredAlertStatusMinimum
fields.description: Lowest alert level the unit may have. -1 ignores it; the condition fails when both limits are -1.

fields.name: ExcludeEffectsMode
fields.description: X2Condition_UnitEffects and its subclasses (merged by EffectName)

fields.name: ExcludeEffects
fields.description: Effects that reject the unit when present, each with the failure reason to return.

fields.name: RequireEffects
fields.description: Effects that must all be present on the unit, each with the failure reason to return.

fields.name: ExcludeDamageTypesMode
fields.description: X2Condition_UnitImmunities

fields.name: ExcludeDamageTypes
fields.description: Damage types; a unit immune to any of them is rejected.

fields.name: OnlyOnCharacterTemplate
fields.description: Consider only the immunities of the unit's character template, not those granted by effects.

fields.name: InteractionType
fields.description: Kind of interaction point the unit must be next to: eInteractionType_Normal or eInteractionType_Hack.

fields.name: RelevantSlot
fields.description: Inventory slot whose item is checked.

fields.name: ExcludeWeaponCategory
fields.description: Weapon category that rejects the unit when the item in RelevantSlot has it.

fields.name: RequireWeaponCategory
fields.description: Weapon category the item in RelevantSlot must have. Fails when the slot is empty.

fields.name: ExcludeAlive
fields.description: Reject living units.

fields.name: ExcludeDead
fields.description: Reject dead units.

fields.name: ExcludeRobotic
fields.description: Reject robotic units.

fields.name: ExcludeOrganic
fields.description: Reject organic units.

fields.name: ExcludeCivilian
fields.description: Reject units whose character template is civilian, whatever their team.

fields.name: ExcludeNonCivilian
fields.description: Reject units whose character template is not civilian, whatever their team.

fields.name: ExcludeCosmetic
fields.description: Reject cosmetic units, such as Gremlins.

fields.name: ExcludeImpaired
fields.description: Reject impaired units.

fields.name: ExcludePanicked
fields.description: Reject panicked units.

fields.name: ExcludeInStasis
fields.description: Reject units in stasis.

fields.name: ExcludeTurret
fields.description: Reject turrets.

fields.name: ExcludePsionic
fields.description: Reject psionic units.

fields.name: ExcludeNonPsionic
fields.description: Reject non-psionic units.

fields.name: IsAdvent
fields.description: Require an ADVENT unit.

fields.name: ExcludeAdvent
fields.description: Reject ADVENT units.

fields.name: ExcludeNoCover
fields.description: Reject units that are not in cover.

fields.name: ExcludeNoCoverToSource
fields.description: Reject units with no cover between them and the source.

fields.name: ExcludeFullHealth
fields.description: Reject units at full HP, unless a persistent damage effect listed in MedikitHealEffectTypes is on them.

fields.name: IsBleedingOut
fields.description: Require a unit that is bleeding out.

fields.name: IsUnspotted
fields.description: Require a unit that has not been spotted.

fields.name: CanBeCarried
fields.description: Require a unit that can be carried.

fields.name: IsOutdoors
fields.description: Require a unit standing outdoors.

fields.name: IsConcealed
fields.description: Require a concealed unit.

fields.name: ExcludeConcealed
fields.description: Reject concealed units. Only applies to the check without a source; visibility rules normally cover this.

fields.name: IsSuperConcealed
fields.description: Require a unit in super concealment.

fields.name: IsImpaired
fields.description: Require an impaired unit.

fields.name: HasClearanceToMaxZ
fields.description: Require open space above the unit up to the map ceiling.

fields.name: ExcludeAlien
fields.description: Reject alien units.

fields.name: ExcludeNonHumanoidAliens
fields.description: Reject aliens that are not humanoid.

fields.name: ExcludeStunned
fields.description: Reject stunned units.

fields.name: ExcludeDazed
fields.description: Reject dazed units.

fields.name: ExcludeUnableToAct
fields.description: Reject units that are unable to act.

fields.name: IsPlayerControlled
fields.description: Require a player-controlled unit.

fields.name: ExcludeUnrevealedAI
fields.description: Reject AI units that have not been revealed yet.

fields.name: IncludeWeakAgainstTechLikeRobot
fields.description: Treat units flagged as weak against tech as robotic for the robotic checks.

fields.name: ImpairedIgnoresStuns
fields.description: Do not count stuns when deciding whether a unit is impaired.

fields.name: IsScampering
fields.description: Require a unit that is currently scampering.

fields.name: ExcludeDeadFromSpecialDeath
fields.description: Reject units killed by a special death.

fields.name: ExcludeLargeUnits
fields.description: Reject units larger than one tile.

fields.name: ImpairedIgnoresImpairingMomentarily
fields.description: Do not count momentary impairment when deciding whether a unit is impaired.

fields.name: MinRank
fields.description: Lowest soldier rank allowed.

fields.name: MaxRank
fields.description: Highest soldier rank allowed.

fields.name: ExcludeSoldierClasses
fields.description: Soldier classes that reject the unit. Non-soldiers always pass.

fields.name: RequireSoldierClasses
fields.description: Soldier classes the unit must be one of, when non-empty. Non-soldiers always fail.

fields.name: ExcludeHostileToSource
fields.description: Reject units hostile to the source.

fields.name: ExcludeFriendlyToSource
fields.description: Reject units friendly to the source.

fields.name: TreatMindControlledSquadmateAsHostile
fields.description: Count a mind-controlled squadmate as hostile rather than friendly.

fields.name: ExcludeSquadmates
fields.description: Reject units on the same team as the source.

fields.name: RequireSquadmates
fields.description: Require the unit to be on the same team as the source.

fields.name: RequireWithinRange
fields.description: Require the unit to be within WithinRange of the source.

fields.name: WithinRange
fields.description: Maximum distance between source and target, in Unreal units. A tile is 96.

fields.name: RequireWithinMinRange
fields.description: Require the unit to be within WithinMinRange of the source.

fields.name: WithinMinRange
fields.description: Distance for the minimum-range check, in Unreal units. A tile is 96.

fields.name: BeingCarriedBySource
fields.description: Require a unit currently carried by the source.

fields.name: RequireUnitSelectedFromHQ
fields.description: Require a unit that was selected from Headquarters for the mission. XCOM only.

fields.name: FailOnNonUnits
fields.description: Fail with AA_NotAUnit on non-unit targets instead of passing them through.

fields.name: CheckStatsMode
fields.description: X2Condition_UnitStatCheck (merged by StatType)

fields.name: CheckStats
fields.description: Stat checks that must all pass: the stat, the value check, and whether to compare as a percentage of the stat's maximum.

fields.name: IncludeTypesMode
fields.description: X2Condition_UnitType

fields.name: IncludeTypes
fields.description: Character groups the unit must belong to, when non-empty. Takes precedence over ExcludeTypes.

fields.name: ExcludeTypes
fields.description: Character groups that reject the unit. Ignored while IncludeTypes is non-empty.

fields.name: CheckValuesMode
fields.description: X2Condition_UnitValue (merged by UnitValue)

fields.name: CheckValues
fields.description: Unit value checks that must all pass: the value name, the value check, and an optional failure code to return instead of the default.

fields.name: NoEnemyViewers
fields.description: Fail when any enemy can see the target.

fields.name: RequireMatchCoverType
fields.description: Require the target to be in the cover type given by TargetCover.

fields.name: RequireNotMatchCoverType
fields.description: Require the target not to be in the cover type given by TargetCover.

fields.name: TargetCover
fields.description: Cover type used by RequireMatchCoverType and RequireNotMatchCoverType.

fields.name: CannotPeek
fields.description: Require the shooter to see the target from its own tile, without peeking.

fields.name: RequireLOS
fields.description: Require line of sight.

fields.name: RequireBasicVisibility
fields.description: Require line of sight and range.

fields.name: RequireGameplayVisible
fields.description: Require line of sight, range and the situational gameplay-visibility rules.

fields.name: AllowSquadsight
fields.description: Accept any squadmate's view of the target if the unit has Squadsight. Overrides RequireGameplayVisible.

fields.name: ActAsSquadsight
fields.description: Accept any squadmate's view of the target whether or not the unit has Squadsight. Overrides RequireGameplayVisible.

fields.name: VisibleToAnyAlly
fields.description: Accept the target when any squadmate can see it, without line of sight from the unit itself. Overrides RequireGameplayVisible.

fields.name: DisablePeeksOnMovement
fields.description: Forbid peeking once the target has moved.

fields.name: ExcludeGameplayVisible
fields.description: Fail when the target has gameplay visibility of the source.

fields.name: RequireGameplayVisibleTags
fields.description: Visibility tags that must be present on the visibility info, such as concealed or stealthed.

fields.name: MissionAborted
fields.description: Require the mission to have been aborted.

fields.name: MissionNotAborted
fields.description: Require the mission not to have been aborted.

fields.name: CiviliansTargetedByAliens
fields.description: Require a mission where aliens target civilians.

fields.name: CiviliansNotTargetedByAliens
fields.description: Require a mission where aliens do not target civilians.

fields.name: IncludeTheLostInEngagedCount
fields.description: Count the Lost among the engaged enemies.

fields.name: MinEngagedEnemies
fields.description: Fewest engaged enemies required. -1 ignores it.

fields.name: MaxEngagedEnemies
fields.description: Most engaged enemies allowed. -1 ignores it.

fields.name: FailOnNonUnitTargets
fields.description: Fail with AA_NotAUnit on non-unit targets instead of passing them through.

fields.name: MinBondLevel
fields.description: Lowest bond level between the two units, inclusive.

fields.name: MaxBondLevel
fields.description: Highest bond level between the two units, inclusive.

fields.name: RequiresAdjacency
fields.description: Whether the bondmates may, must not, or must be adjacent: EAR_AnyAdjacency, EAR_DisallowAdjacency or EAR_RequireAdjacency.

fields.name: SkipCheckWithSource
fields.description: Only check that the source has a bondmate on the mission, not that the target is that bondmate. For self-targeted bondmate abilities.

fields.name: IntrusionProtocol
fields.description: Hack objects at range: needs gameplay visibility of the object instead of an adjacent interaction point.

fields.name: HaywireProtocol
fields.description: Target units instead of objects: living, unhacked, robotic enemies the unit sees or has squadsight on.

fields.name: RequiredAbilityName
fields.description: Ability the interactive object must expose. For hacking, empty accepts any object; for a normal interaction it must match exactly.

fields.name: MustBeDoor
fields.description: Require the object to be a door.

fields.name: RestrictRange
fields.description: Require the loot to be within LootableRange of the source.

fields.name: LootableRange
fields.description: Maximum distance to the loot, in Unreal units, when RestrictRange is set. A tile is 96.

fields.name: NotAFloorTileTag
fields.description: Tag of tiles that must not count as ground.

fields.name: MaxPanicUnitsPerPod
fields.description: Most units of an AI pod that may be panicked at once. 0 removes the limit.

fields.name: HackAbilityName
fields.description: Hack ability whose rewards the target must offer, e.g. FinalizeSKULLJACK.

fields.name: CheckFlanking
fields.description: Fail when any enemy flanks the unit.

fields.name: RequireVisible
fields.description: Require a free neighbouring tile the unit could be pulled to, rather than any free neighbouring tile.

fields.name: AllowedBiomesMode
fields.description: X2Condition_MapProperty

fields.name: AllowedBiomes
fields.description: Map biomes the mission must be in, when non-empty.

fields.name: CustomProperties
fields.description: Free-form key/value pairs for bridge-mod editors; ignored by the built-in editors.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Effect class to target/instantiate, e.g. `X2Effect_ApplyWeaponDamage`. Bare names are auto-prefixed with `XComGame.`; empty falls back to `X2Effect`.

fields.name: Slot
fields.description: Which effect array to edit (`EAbilityEffectSlot`): `eAES_Target`, `eAES_MultiTarget` or `eAES_Shooter`.

fields.name: Mode
fields.description: Per-entry edit mode (`EArrayEditMode`). Defaults to the enum's first value, which clears the existing array.

fields.name: ApplyOnTickClass
fields.description: Redirects this entry at an effect nested in the parent's `ApplyOnTick` list, so every other field below applies to that child instead. Only `X2Effect_Persistent` and its subclasses have one. Use it to reach the damage of a damage-over-time effect: the `X2Effect_Burning` object itself only carries duration, while the per-tick damage lives in an `X2Effect_ApplyWeaponDamage` beneath it. Bare names are auto-prefixed with `XComGame.`.

fields.name: ApplyOnTickIndex
fields.description: Which matching child to edit when several in `ApplyOnTick` share the same class. Counts only matches of `ApplyOnTickClass`, so 0 is the first one. Default 0.

fields.name: ApplyOnTickMode
fields.description: What to do when `ApplyOnTickClass` is not already in the list (`EArrayEditMode`): `eAEM_Merge`/`eAEM_AddOnly` append one, `eAEM_Remove` removes it, `eAEM_ReplaceAll` clears the list first. Ignored when `ApplyOnTickClass` is empty.

fields.name: ApplyOnHit
fields.description: Whether the effect is applied when the ability hits. Most effects want this true; setting it false is how an effect is made to trigger only on a miss.

fields.name: ApplyOnMiss
fields.description: Whether the effect is applied even when the ability misses.

fields.name: ApplyChance
fields.description: Percentage chance the effect applies at all, rolled per target. 0 behaves as "always", since the roll is only made when a chance is set.

fields.name: ApplyToWorldOnHit
fields.description: Whether the effect is applied to the world (tiles, cover, environment) on a hit, rather than to a unit. Used by fire, smoke, acid and the other world effects.

fields.name: ApplyToWorldOnMiss
fields.description: As ApplyToWorldOnHit, but for a miss. Grenades typically set both, so they still affect the ground when they scatter.

fields.name: UseSourcePlayerState
fields.description: Records the source player on the effect when it is applied, so later logic can tell whose effect it was. Needed by effects that behave differently for XCOM and the AI.

fields.name: IsImpairing
fields.description: Marks the effect as impairing the unit, which fires the impairment event and makes the unit report as impaired. This is what stuns, panic and disorientation use.

fields.name: IsImpairingMomentarily
fields.description: Fires the impairment event without leaving the unit flagged as impaired afterwards. For effects that interrupt an action but do not linger.

fields.name: BringRemoveVisualizationForward
fields.description: Moves this effect's removal visualization earlier in the sequence, taking the whole context's visualization with it. Used when a removal must be seen before what follows.

fields.name: ShowImmunity
fields.description: Shows a flyover when the target is immune to this effect. Only when the application actually failed because of immunity.

fields.name: ShowImmunityAnyFailure
fields.description: Shows the immunity flyover whenever the effect fails to apply for any reason, not only immunity. Broader, and noisier, than ShowImmunity.

fields.name: AppliesDamage
fields.description: Marks the effect as dealing damage, so it counts towards damage statistics and raises the generic ability-damage events. Set it on any custom source of damage.

fields.name: CanBeRedirected
fields.description: Whether the effect is eligible to be redirected onto another target, by Untouchable, Bladestorm parries and similar. Leave false for effects that must hit their target.

fields.name: HideDeathWorldMessage
fields.description: Suppresses the usual death message when this effect is what kills the unit, for deaths that should read as something other than a normal kill.

fields.name: DamageTypes
fields.description: Damage types this effect counts as. A unit immune to any type listed here resists the effect, and cleansing effects look at these types to decide what they can remove.

fields.name: TargetConditions
fields.description: Conditions attached to the effect (X2Effect.TargetConditions)

fields.name: MinStatContestResult
fields.description: For effects resolved by a stat contest: the contest result must be at least this for the effect to apply. Used to band outcomes, so a stronger roll applies a stronger effect.

fields.name: MaxStatContestResult
fields.description: Upper bound of the same stat-contest band. Ignored when it is below MinStatContestResult.

fields.name: DelayVisualizationSec
fields.description: Seconds to delay this effect's visualization, for sequencing it against the rest of the ability rather than changing any game state.

fields.name: OverrideMissMessage
fields.description: Replaces the usual "Miss" flyover with your own text, for abilities where a miss should read as something else.

fields.name: NumTurns
fields.description: How many turns the effect lasts. Ignored when InfiniteDuration is true.

fields.name: InitialShedChance
fields.description: Percentage chance the effect is shed immediately on the first tick, before PerTurnShedChance takes over.

fields.name: PerTurnShedChance
fields.description: Percentage chance per tick that the effect wears off early. 0 means it only ends when its turns run out.

fields.name: EffectRank
fields.description: Precedence among effects of the same kind, used by auras so a stronger source wins over a weaker one.

fields.name: EffectHierarchyValue
fields.description: Decides which effect controls the unit’s animation when several apply at once. The higher value wins.

fields.name: VisionArcDegreesOverride
fields.description: Narrows the unit’s sight arc to this many degrees. When two effects both set it, the smaller arc applies.

fields.name: InfiniteDuration
fields.description: The effect never expires on its own. It then only ends through one of the RemoveWhen... rules below, or by something cleansing it.

fields.name: TickWhenApplied
fields.description: Ticks once the moment it is applied, rather than waiting for the turn to come round. Damage-over-time effects use this to hurt immediately.

fields.name: CanTickEveryAction
fields.description: Ticks after every action the target takes rather than once a turn, where the character template supports it.

fields.name: ConvertTurnsToActions
fields.description: When ticking per action, multiplies NumTurns by the actions available per turn, so a "3 turn" effect still lasts roughly three turns.

fields.name: RemoveWhenSourceDies
fields.description: Removes the effect when whoever applied it dies. Typical for effects sustained by their caster, such as mind control.

fields.name: RemoveWhenTargetDies
fields.description: Removes the effect when the affected unit dies, rather than leaving it on the body.

fields.name: RemoveWhenSourceDamaged
fields.description: Removes the effect as soon as the source takes damage, for concentration-style effects broken by being hit.

fields.name: RemoveWhenTargetConcealmentBroken
fields.description: Removes the effect when the target loses concealment. Used by effects that only make sense while hidden.

fields.name: PersistThroughTacticalGameEnd
fields.description: Keeps the effect on the unit after it leaves play, until the mission ends. Needed by effects that must still be read when the mission is scored.

fields.name: IgnorePlayerCheckOnTick
fields.description: Ticks regardless of whose turn it is. Normally an effect only ticks on its owner’s turn.

fields.name: UniqueTarget
fields.description: Only one target may carry this effect from a given source at a time; applying it elsewhere removes the earlier one.

fields.name: StackOnRefresh
fields.description: Re-applying the effect increments a stack counter instead of simply refreshing its duration, so effects that grow with repetition can read the count.

fields.name: DupeForSameSourceOnly
fields.description: When checking whether the target already has this effect, only consider copies from the same source. Lets several units apply their own instance.

fields.name: EffectForcesBleedout
fields.description: A unit reduced to zero health while under this effect bleeds out instead of dying outright.

fields.name: DisplayInUI
fields.description: Whether the effect appears in the unit’s status UI at all. An effect with no FriendlyName set will show as blank.

fields.name: DisplayInSpecialDamageMessageUI
fields.description: Shows FriendlyName in the damage feedback as a distinct source, so its damage reads separately from the weapon’s.

fields.name: SourceDisplayInUI
fields.description: As DisplayInUI, but for the unit that applied the effect rather than the one carrying it.

fields.name: CustomIdleOverrideAnim
fields.description: Idle animation to play while the effect is active, taking over the unit’s normal idle.

fields.name: EffectName
fields.description: Identifier used when deciding how this effect stacks with others, and the name other effects use to find or remove it.

fields.name: AbilitySourceName
fields.description: Which ability this is presented as coming from. Controls how a passive buff is coloured in the HUD.

fields.name: EffectAppliedEventName
fields.description: Event fired when the effect is applied, for listeners and triggered abilities to react to.

fields.name: ChanceEventTriggerName
fields.description: Event fired when the per-turn shed-chance roll succeeds.

fields.name: VFXSocket
fields.description: Socket on the unit’s skeleton to attach the particle system to.

fields.name: VFXSocketsArrayName
fields.description: Named array of sockets to attach the particle system to, for effects that appear in several places at once. Optional.

fields.name: FriendlyName
fields.description: Name shown in the unit’s status UI.

fields.name: FriendlyDescription
fields.description: Description shown beneath FriendlyName in the status UI.

fields.name: IconImage
fields.description: Path to the status icon shown in the UI.

fields.name: SourceFriendlyName
fields.description: Name shown on the unit that applied the effect, as opposed to the one carrying it.

fields.name: SourceFriendlyDescription
fields.description: Description shown on the applying unit.

fields.name: SourceIconLabel
fields.description: Short label drawn on the applying unit’s icon.

fields.name: StatusIcon
fields.description: Path to the small status icon used in condensed UI, alongside IconImage.

fields.name: VFXTemplateName
fields.description: Particle system played on the unit for as long as the effect lasts.

fields.name: PersistentPerkName
fields.description: Perk effect played on the unit while this effect is active.

fields.name: ExplosiveDamage
fields.description: Counts the damage as explosive, so explosive-specific rules such as Blast Padding apply.

fields.name: IgnoreBaseDamage
fields.description: Leave out the weapon's base damage; only the effect's own damage and tagged extra damage apply.

fields.name: DamageTag
fields.description: Tag selecting one of the weapon's ExtraDamage entries and the upgrade bonus damage with the same tag.

fields.name: AlwaysKillsCivilians
fields.description: Civilian targets die outright regardless of the damage rolled.

fields.name: ApplyWorldEffectsForEachTargetLocation
fields.description: Apply the ability's world effects at every target location instead of once.

fields.name: AllowFreeKill
fields.description: Let free-kill weapon upgrades, such as the Repeater, trigger on this damage.

fields.name: AllowWeaponUpgrade
fields.description: Let weapon upgrades add their bonus damage.

fields.name: BypassShields
fields.description: Damage ignores shield HP and goes straight to health.

fields.name: IgnoreArmor
fields.description: Damage ignores armor.

fields.name: BypassSustainEffects
fields.description: Damage ignores sustain effects that would otherwise keep the unit alive.

fields.name: EnvironmentalDamageAmount
fields.description: Environmental damage dealt to terrain and cover.

fields.name: WeaponDamageValue
fields.description: Damage the effect adds on its own, on top of the weapon: Damage, Spread, Crit, Pierce, Shred, Rupture, PlusOne, DamageType and Tag.

fields.name: StatChangeMode
fields.description: X2Effect_PersistentStatChange

fields.name: StatChange
fields.description: Stat changes applied while the effect lasts, merged by StatType.

fields.name: CHLForceReapplyOnRefresh
fields.description: Re-apply the stat changes when the effect is refreshed. Community Highlander field.

fields.name: ImmuneTypesAreInclusive
fields.description: true: immune to the listed damage types only. false: immune to every damage type except the listed ones.

fields.name: RemoveAfterAttackCount
fields.description: Remove the effect after this many attacks against the unit. 0 keeps it.

fields.name: ImmuneTypes
fields.description: Damage types the immunity covers, or excludes when ImmuneTypesAreInclusive is false.

fields.name: NumActionPoints
fields.description: Action points granted.

fields.name: PointType
fields.description: Type of action point granted, e.g. standard or move.

fields.name: ApplyOnlyWhenOut
fields.description: Grant only when the unit has no standard action points left.

fields.name: SelectUnit
fields.description: Select the unit in the tactical UI once the points are granted.

fields.name: SkipWithEffect
fields.description: Effects that, when present on the unit, skip the grant.

fields.name: RecordUnitValueWithGrantMode
fields.description: X2Effect_GrantActionPointsWithRecord (merged by UnitValueName)

fields.name: RecordUnitValueWithGrant
fields.description: Unit values that accumulate the action points granted, each with its cleanup rule. Merge updates the entry with the same UnitValueName or adds it.

fields.name: EffectNamesToRemoveMode
fields.description: X2Effect_RemoveEffects

fields.name: EffectNamesToRemove
fields.description: Effect names removed from the target.

fields.name: Cleanse
fields.description: Remove the effects as a cleanse, so whatever they do on wearing off does not trigger.

fields.name: CheckSource
fields.description: Match effects whose source is this effect's target, instead of effects whose target it is.

fields.name: DoNotVisualize
fields.description: Skip the removal visualization, for when another RemoveEffects on the ability already shows it.

fields.name: UnitName
fields.description: Unit value written.

fields.name: NewValueToSet
fields.description: Value written to the unit value.

fields.name: CleanupType
fields.description: When the unit value is cleared: eCleanup_BeginTurn, eCleanup_BeginTactical, eCleanup_Never or eCleanup_BeginTacticalChain.

fields.name: ArmorMitigationAmount
fields.description: Armor points granted while the effect lasts.

fields.name: StunLevel
fields.description: Action points the stun takes away.

fields.name: SkipAnimation
fields.description: Skip the stun animations.

fields.name: StunStartAnimName
fields.description: Animation played when the stun starts, if the unit can play it.

fields.name: StunStopAnimName
fields.description: Animation played when the stun ends.

fields.name: StunnedTriggerName
fields.description: Event fired when the unit is stunned.

fields.name: SustainedAbilityName
fields.description: Ability on the source that is fired again once a full turn completes, to keep the effect going.

fields.name: FragileAmount
fields.description: Damage the source may take in a full turn before the effect breaks. 0 never breaks it.

fields.name: EffectsToRemoveFromSource
fields.description: Effects removed from the source when this effect ends.

fields.name: EffectsToRemoveFromTarget
fields.description: Effects removed from the target when this effect ends.

fields.name: RegisterAdditionalEventsLikeImpair
fields.description: Extra events on the source that end the effect as if the source had become impaired.

fields.name: ReasonNotVisible

fields.name: VanishRevealAdditiveAnimName
fields.description: Additive animation played on reveal when VanishRevealAnimName is empty.

fields.name: VanishRevealAnimName
fields.description: Animation played when the unit is revealed.

fields.name: VanishSyncAnimName
fields.description: Additive animation played when the vanished state is visualized from a save.

fields.name: ReserveType

fields.name: NumPoints
fields.description: Number of action points reserved.

fields.name: AbilityToActivate

fields.name: GrantActionPoint

fields.name: MaxPointsPerTurn
fields.description: Most times per turn the action point can be granted. 0 or less removes the limit.

fields.name: DirectAttackOnly
fields.description: Only match when the unit carrying the effect is attacked directly.

fields.name: PreEmptiveFire
fields.description: Fire before the attacker's shot resolves instead of after it.

fields.name: OnlyDuringEnemyTurn
fields.description: Only fire during the enemy turn.

fields.name: UseMultiTargets
fields.description: Fire the ability at the covering unit itself and hit its multi-targets, instead of retaliating at the attacker.

fields.name: OnlyWhenAttackMisses
fields.description: Only fire when the attack missed.

fields.name: SelfTargeting
fields.description: The fired ability targets the covering unit itself.

fields.name: ActivationPercentChance
fields.description: Percent chance the ability fires when the check matches. 0 always fires.

fields.name: TraversalChangesMode

fields.name: TraversalChanges

fields.name: ToHitMin

fields.name: AlertRangeMeters

fields.name: BonusDamageMult

fields.name: MinBonusDamage

fields.name: AcidParticleSystem2Tiles

fields.name: AcidParticleSystem4TilesS

fields.name: AcidParticleSystem4TilesReverseS

fields.name: OverrideParticleSystem
fields.description: Particle system path played on the target instead of the default one. Empty keeps the default.

fields.name: DamageTypeTemplateName

fields.name: PlusNumZTiles
fields.description: Extra tiles of height hit above the affected tile.

fields.name: UseWeaponEnvironmentalDamage
fields.description: Use the source weapon's environmental damage instead of EnvironmentalDamageAmount.

fields.name: UseWeaponDamageType
fields.description: Use the source weapon's damage type instead of DamageTypeTemplateName.

fields.name: HitSourceTile
fields.description: Apply the damage at the source's tile.

fields.name: HitTargetTile
fields.description: Apply the damage at the target's tile.

fields.name: HitAdjacentDestructibles
fields.description: Also damage destructibles adjacent to the hit tile along the damage direction.

fields.name: AllowDestructionOfDamageCauseCover
fields.description: When a unit caused the damage, allow it to destroy that unit's own cover, which is normally protected.

fields.name: FireChance_Level1

fields.name: FireChance_Level2
fields.description: Weight of a level 2 fire when rolling the intensity of new fires; relative to the other two levels.

fields.name: FireChance_Level3
fields.description: Weight of a level 3 fire when rolling the intensity of new fires; relative to the other two levels.

fields.name: UseFireChanceLevel
fields.description: Roll the fire intensity from the three FireChance weights instead of using the default.

fields.name: DamageFragileOnly
fields.description: Only damage fragile objects.

fields.name: CheckForLOSFromTargetLocation
fields.description: Only set tiles on fire that are visible from the target location.

fields.name: PerUseHP
fields.description: HP healed per application.

fields.name: IncreasedHealProject
fields.description: Research that, once completed, switches the heal to IncreasedPerUseHP.

fields.name: IncreasedPerUseHP
fields.description: HP healed per application once IncreasedHealProject is researched.

fields.name: PoisonParticleSystem
fields.description: Particle system path for a poison cloud tile.

fields.name: SmokeParticleSystem
fields.description: Particle system path for a smoke tile.

fields.name: Pierce
fields.description: Armor pierced.

fields.name: CritChance
fields.description: Crit chance added.

fields.name: CritDamage
fields.description: Crit damage added.

fields.name: EventsToUpdateMode
fields.description: X2Effect_Aura

fields.name: EventsToUpdate
fields.description: Events that make the aura re-evaluate which units it covers.

fields.name: NumHitsForMod
fields.description: Hits taken in the turn before the damage multiplier applies.

fields.name: ExplosiveDamageReduction
fields.description: Fraction of explosive damage removed.

fields.name: BonusDamage
fields.description: Bonus damage added when the effect's condition is met.

fields.name: ThreatenedBondmateAimBonus
fields.description: Aim bonus, from bond level 2, against a target that threatens the bondmate.

fields.name: BondmateTargetAimBonus
fields.description: Aim bonus, from bond level 3, against a target the bondmate attacked since last turn.

fields.name: BondmateTargetCritBonus
fields.description: Crit bonus, from bond level 3, against a target the bondmate attacked since last turn.

fields.name: BleedoutDurationAdjustment
fields.description: Turns added to the bleedout duration.

fields.name: BonusDmg
fields.description: Bonus damage added to the weapon's damage.

fields.name: WillMod
fields.description: Change applied to the target's current Will; negative lowers it.

fields.name: DamageTypeImmunitiesMode
fields.description: X2Effect_CombatStims, X2Effect_Solace

fields.name: DamageTypeImmunities
fields.description: Damage types the affected unit is immune to while the effect lasts.

fields.name: ModifyOutgoingDamage
fields.description: Apply to damage the unit deals.

fields.name: ModifyIncomingDamage
fields.description: Apply to damage the unit takes.

fields.name: DamageModifier
fields.description: Damage multiplier; 1.0 leaves the damage unchanged.

fields.name: DamageBonus
fields.description: Flat damage added after the multiplier.

fields.name: DamageMultiplier
fields.description: Extra damage as a fraction of the damage being dealt.

fields.name: TriggerEventName
fields.description: Event the effect fires.

fields.name: GlobalAbility
fields.description: Global ability switched on for the rest of the battle.

fields.name: DamageImmunitiesMode
fields.description: X2Effect_Fortress

fields.name: DamageImmunities
fields.description: Damage types the unit is immune to. The game assumes Fire, Acid and Poison are among them.

fields.name: CoverType
fields.description: Cover the unit provides to others: none, low or high (ECoverForceFlag).

fields.name: RemoveWhenMoved
fields.description: Remove the effect when the unit moves.

fields.name: RemoveOnOtherActivation
fields.description: Remove the effect when the unit activates another ability.

fields.name: OverrideStartAnimName
fields.description: Animation played on the pulled unit at the start, when set.

fields.name: OverrideStopAnimName
fields.description: Animation played on the pulled unit at the end, when set.

fields.name: RequireVisibleTile

fields.name: HeightBonus

fields.name: AllowedAbilitiesMode

fields.name: ProcChance

fields.name: HitMod

fields.name: DelayTimeS

fields.name: AbilityToTrigger

fields.name: BonusCritChance
fields.description: Crit chance added when the effect's condition is met.

fields.name: ConeLength
fields.description: Length of the marked cone from the source to the target.

fields.name: ConeEndDiameter
fields.description: Diameter of the marked cone at its far end.

fields.name: PassTargetAsSource
fields.description: Fire the event with the target as its source.

fields.name: ActionPointType
fields.description: Type of action point added, or removed, at the start of the turn.

fields.name: ActionPointsRemoved
fields.description: Remove the action points instead of adding them.

fields.name: MovingVanishRevealAdditiveAnimName
fields.description: Additive animation played on reveal when the unit is revealed while moving.

fields.name: DamagePerAction
fields.description: Damage dealt for each action point stolen.

fields.name: HealthReturnMod
fields.description: Fraction of the damage dealt that is returned to the source as health.

fields.name: WallBreakingEffectName
fields.description: Name of the effect on the unit that grants wall breaking.

fields.name: CenterTile
fields.description: Apply the world effect to the centre tile only.

fields.name: StatTypesToRestoreMode
fields.description: X2Effect_PersistentStatChangeRestoreDefault

fields.name: StatTypesToRestore
fields.description: Stats reset to their default value while the effect lasts.

fields.name: ApplyDamageModConditions
fields.description: X2Effect_ConditionalDamageModifier

fields.name: LethalDamageConditions
fields.description: X2Effect_LethalWeaponDamage

fields.name: ToHitConditions
fields.description: X2Effect_ToHitModifier

fields.name: EffectHitModifiers
fields.description: **Replace-only**: when non-empty, replaces `X2Effect_ToHitModifier.Modifiers` entirely (`EffectHitModifier` entries, incl. `MatchToHit` class ref via qualified name).

fields.name: CustomProperties
fields.description: Free-form key/value pairs for bridge-mod editors; ignored by the built-in editors.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Optional. Omitted = edit the existing calc in place. Set = target/instantiate that class, e.g. `X2AbilityToHitCalc_StandardAim`. Bare names are auto-prefixed with `XComGame.`.

fields.name: HitModifiers
fields.description: **Replace-only**: when non-empty, replaces the calc's always-on `HitModifiers` array entirely (`ShotModifierInfo`: `ModType`, `Value`, `Reason`).

fields.name: IndirectFire
fields.description: Treats the attack as indirect, like a grenade: it always hits, though crit, dodge and armour mitigation still apply.

fields.name: MeleeAttack
fields.description: Treats the attack as melee, which ignores cover and applies the intrinsic melee hit bonus.

fields.name: ReactionFire
fields.description: Treats the attack as reaction fire, which takes the reaction penalty and forgoes the flanking bonus.

fields.name: AllowCrit
fields.description: Whether crits are built into the hit table at all. Turning it off makes the ability incapable of critting.

fields.name: HitsAreCrits
fields.description: Converts every successful hit into a crit after the roll is made.

fields.name: MultiTargetOnly
fields.description: Guarantees success when the ability has no primary target, for abilities that only ever hit multi-targets.

fields.name: OnlyMultiHitWithSuccess
fields.description: Multi-target hits only land if the roll succeeded, as with Faceoff.

fields.name: GuaranteedHit
fields.description: Always hits, skipping the normal hit modifiers. Armour mitigation still rolls.

fields.name: IgnoreCoverBonus
fields.description: Ignores the target's high and low cover bonuses.

fields.name: FinalMultiplier
fields.description: Scales the final hit chance after everything else. Appears in the shot breakdown attributed to the ability.

fields.name: BuiltInHitMod
fields.description: Flat aim modifier the ability always carries.

fields.name: BuiltInCritMod
fields.description: Flat crit modifier the ability always carries.

fields.name: PercentToHit
fields.description: Flat percentage chance to hit, ignoring aim entirely. For abilities whose odds are fixed rather than calculated.

fields.name: NoGameStateOnMiss
fields.description: Produces no game state at all on a miss, so nothing is recorded or visualised.

fields.name: FocusMultiplier
fields.description: Percentage points added to the hit chance per point of Templar focus.

fields.name: PercentToHitInBuddyZone
fields.description: Replaces PercentToHit when the target is inside the buddy zone.

fields.name: AlwaysSucceed
fields.description: Makes the hack always succeed.

fields.name: StatToRoll
fields.description: Which unit stat the roll is made against.

fields.name: BaseChance
fields.description: Base percentage before the stat is taken into account.

fields.name: BaseValue
fields.description: Base value the stat contest is measured against.

fields.name: AttackerStat
fields.description: Attacker's stat in a unit-versus-unit contest.

fields.name: DefenderStat
fields.description: Defender's stat in a unit-versus-unit contest.

fields.name: CustomProperties
fields.description: Free-form key/value pairs for bridge-mod editors; ignored by the built-in editors.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Optional. Omitted = edit the existing style in place. Set = target/instantiate that class, e.g. `X2AbilityTarget_Cursor`. Bare names are auto-prefixed with `XComGame.`.

fields.name: OnlyIncludeTargetsInsideWeaponRange
fields.description: Excludes targets beyond the weapon's range from selection.

fields.name: AllowInteractiveObjects
fields.description: Lets the ability target interactive objects such as doors and consoles.

fields.name: AllowDestructibleObjects
fields.description: Lets the ability target destructible scenery.

fields.name: IncludeSelf
fields.description: Lets the user target itself.

fields.name: ShowAOE
fields.description: Draws the area-of-effect preview while aiming.

fields.name: RestrictToWeaponRange
fields.description: Limits the cursor to the weapon's range.

fields.name: IncreaseWeaponRange
fields.description: Extra range in tiles beyond the weapon's own, when restricted to weapon range.

fields.name: RestrictToSquadsightRange
fields.description: Limits the cursor to squadsight range rather than the weapon's.

fields.name: FixedAbilityRange
fields.description: Fixed range in tiles, ignoring the weapon entirely.

fields.name: MovementRangeAdjustment
fields.description: Tiles added to or removed from how far the unit may move to reach a melee target.

fields.name: CustomProperties
fields.description: Free-form key/value pairs for bridge-mod editors; ignored by the built-in editors.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Optional. Omitted = edit the existing style in place. Set = target/instantiate that class, e.g. `X2AbilityMultiTarget_Radius`. Bare names are auto-prefixed with `XComGame.`.

fields.name: AllowSameTarget
fields.description: Lets the primary target also be picked up as a multi-target.

fields.name: UseSourceWeaponLocation
fields.description: Measures the area from the shooter's weapon rather than the unit.

fields.name: NumTargetsRequired
fields.description: Minimum targets that must be in the area for the ability to be usable.

fields.name: UseWeaponRadius
fields.description: Takes the radius from the weapon. TargetRadius is then added on top.

fields.name: UseWeaponBlockingCoverFlag
fields.description: Takes the weapon's setting for whether cover blocks the area.

fields.name: IgnoreBlockingCover
fields.description: Lets the area pass through cover that would otherwise block it.

fields.name: TargetRadius
fields.description: Radius of the area in metres. Added to the weapon's radius when UseWeaponRadius is set.

fields.name: TargetCoveragePercentage
fields.description: How much of a tile the area must cover before that tile counts as affected.

fields.name: AddPrimaryTargetAsMultiTarget
fields.description: Moves the primary target into the multi-target list, so it is treated as part of the area rather than separately.

fields.name: AllowDeadMultiTargetUnits
fields.description: Includes already-dead units in the area.

fields.name: ExcludeSelfAsTargetIfWithinRadius
fields.description: Leaves the user out of its own area of effect.

fields.name: AbilityBonusRadiiMode
fields.description: merged by RequiredAbility

fields.name: AbilityBonusRadii
fields.description: Extra radius granted when the unit has a particular ability, merged by RequiredAbility. Lets a perk widen the blast without a separate ability.

fields.name: ConeEndDiameter
fields.description: Width of the cone at its far end, in metres.

fields.name: ConeLength
fields.description: How far the cone reaches, in metres.

fields.name: UseWeaponRangeForLength
fields.description: Takes the cone's length from the weapon's range instead of ConeLength.

fields.name: LockShooterZ
fields.description: Restricts the cone to tiles at the shooter's own height, so it does not spread up or down floors.

fields.name: AbilityBonusConesMode

fields.name: AbilityBonusCones

fields.name: TileWidthExtension

fields.name: SightRangeLimited

fields.name: AbilityBonusWidthsMode
fields.description: merged by RequiredAbility

fields.name: AbilityBonusWidths
fields.description: Extra line width granted by a particular ability, merged by RequiredAbility.

fields.name: TargetHeight
fields.description: Height of the cylinder in metres.

fields.name: UseOnlyGroundTiles
fields.description: Restricts the cylinder to ground-level tiles.

fields.name: NumExtraShots
fields.description: Additional shots fired at the same target beyond the first.

fields.name: OnlyAllyOfType
fields.description: Restricts targeting to allies of this character type.

fields.name: AcceptFriendlyUnits
fields.description: Includes friendly units.

fields.name: AcceptEnemyUnits
fields.description: Includes hostile units.

fields.name: OnlyAcceptRoboticUnits
fields.description: Restricts targeting to robotic units.

fields.name: OnlyAcceptAlienUnits
fields.description: Restricts targeting to aliens.

fields.name: OnlyAcceptAdventUnits
fields.description: Restricts targeting to ADVENT units.

fields.name: RandomlySelectOne
fields.description: Picks a single target at random from everything that qualified.

fields.name: DontAcceptNeutralUnits
fields.description: Leaves civilians and other neutrals out.

fields.name: RandomChance
fields.description: Percentage chance each qualifying unit is actually included.

fields.name: UseAbilitySourceAsPrimaryTarget

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Trigger class to target/instantiate, e.g. `X2AbilityTrigger_UnitPostBeginPlay`. Bare names are auto-prefixed with `XComGame.`.

fields.name: Mode
fields.description: Per-entry edit mode (`EArrayEditMode`). Defaults to the enum's first value, which clears the existing array.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: Order this trigger runs in relative to others on the same event. Lower runs first.

fields.name: ListenerEventID
fields.description: Event this listener waits for. The handling function can only be assigned in code, so a listener added purely from config never fires - editing an existing one does.

fields.name: ListenerDeferral
fields.description: When the listener runs relative to the event being processed.

fields.name: ListenerFilter
fields.description: Which units the event is accepted from, such as only the source or only the target.

fields.name: ListenerPriority
fields.description: Order among listeners for the same event.

fields.name: MethodName
fields.description: Method on the observer class that the trigger calls.

fields.name: EventObserverClass
fields.description: Class that observes the event. Loaded by name at runtime.

fields.name: CustomProperties
fields.description: Free-form key/value pairs for bridge-mod editors; ignored by the built-in editors.

fields.name: EventID
fields.description: Matches the existing `Template.AbilityEventListeners` entry to edit. Entries cannot be added (their `EventFn` delegate is code-only).

fields.name: Ability
fields.description: Required. Template name of the ability to edit, or - with `Create=true` - to create (e.g. `SwordSlice`).

fields.name: Create
fields.description: Create the ability when no template of that name exists, then apply the rest of the entry to it. If it already exists, a warning is logged and the entry is applied as a normal edit.

fields.name: CloneFrom
fields.description: With `Create=true`: existing ability to deep-copy as the starting point. Its costs, cooldown, charges, effects (including their `ApplyOnTick` and condition lists), conditions, triggers and styles are copied, not shared, so editing the copy never changes the original. Empty = blank template built by `Preset`. If the source does not exist, nothing is created.

fields.name: Preset
fields.description: Blank creation only (`Create=true`, no `CloneFrom`): which standard game-state and visualization functions the new ability runs (`EAbilityCreatePreset`). Ignored when `CloneFrom` is set.

fields.name: Hostility
fields.description: Whether the ability is offensive, defensive or neutral. Drives AI targeting and the reticle colour. One of eHostility_Offensive, eHostility_Defensive, eHostility_Neutral.

fields.name: ConcealmentRule
fields.description: What happens to the shooter's concealment when the ability is used.

fields.name: ShooterConditions
fields.description: Template-level condition arrays

fields.name: ToHitCalc

fields.name: TargetStyle
fields.description: Targeting style slots

fields.name: Triggers
fields.description: Trigger array + event listener edits

fields.name: FlyOverText

fields.name: TargetingMethod
fields.description: Qualified class path of the targeting method, e.g. XComGame.X2TargetingMethod_OverTheShoulder. The class default is X2TargetingMethod_TopDown.

fields.name: CinescriptCameraType

fields.name: AbilityConfirmSound
fields.description: Sound played when the ability is confirmed in the HUD, e.g. TacticalUI_SwordConfirm.

fields.name: ActivationSpeech

families.name: Effects
families.intro: Edits the effect arrays of the template. `Slot` selects which array is edited (see `EAbilityEffectSlot`). Within the selected array the effect of class `Class` is edited **in place** if present; otherwise behaviour depends on `Mode`.

fields.description: Whether the effect is applied when the ability hits. Most effects want this true; setting it false is how an effect is made to trigger only on a miss.
Whether the effect is applied even when the ability misses.
Percentage chance the effect applies at all, rolled per target. 0 behaves as "always", since the roll is only made when a chance is set.
Whether the effect is applied to the world (tiles, cover, environment) on a hit, rather than to a unit. Used by fire, smoke, acid and the other world effects.
As ApplyToWorldOnHit, but for a miss. Grenades typically set both, so they still affect the ground when they scatter.
Records the source player on the effect when it is applied, so later logic can tell whose effect it was. Needed by effects that behave differently for XCOM and the AI.
Marks the effect as impairing the unit, which fires the impairment event and makes the unit report as impaired. This is what stuns, panic and disorientation use.
Fires the impairment event without leaving the unit flagged as impaired afterwards. For effects that interrupt an action but do not linger.
Moves this effect's removal visualization earlier in the sequence, taking the whole context's visualization with it. Used when a removal must be seen before what follows.
Shows a flyover when the target is immune to this effect. Only when the application actually failed because of immunity.
Shows the immunity flyover whenever the effect fails to apply for any reason, not only immunity. Broader, and noisier, than ShowImmunity.
Marks the effect as dealing damage, so it counts towards damage statistics and raises the generic ability-damage events. Set it on any custom source of damage.
Whether the effect is eligible to be redirected onto another target, by Untouchable, Bladestorm parries and similar. Leave false for effects that must hit their target.
Suppresses the usual death message when this effect is what kills the unit, for deaths that should read as something other than a normal kill.
For effects resolved by a stat contest: the contest result must be at least this for the effect to apply. Used to band outcomes, so a stronger roll applies a stronger effect.
Upper bound of the same stat-contest band. Ignored when it is below MinStatContestResult.
Seconds to delay this effect's visualization, for sequencing it against the rest of the ability rather than changing any game state.
Replaces the usual "Miss" flyover with your own text, for abilities where a miss should read as something else.
Damage types this effect counts as. A unit immune to any type listed here resists the effect, and cleansing effects look at these types to decide what they can remove.
Conditions attached to the effect (X2Effect.TargetConditions)
Unit value holding the object ID of the obsessed-over target.
Re-apply the stat changes when the effect is refreshed. Community Highlander field.
Stat changes applied while the effect lasts, merged by StatType.
The effect never expires on its own. It then only ends through one of the RemoveWhen... rules below, or by something cleansing it.
Ticks once the moment it is applied, rather than waiting for the turn to come round. Damage-over-time effects use this to hurt immediately.
Ticks after every action the target takes rather than once a turn, where the character template supports it.
When ticking per action, multiplies NumTurns by the actions available per turn, so a "3 turn" effect still lasts roughly three turns.
Removes the effect when whoever applied it dies. Typical for effects sustained by their caster, such as mind control.
Removes the effect when the affected unit dies, rather than leaving it on the body.
Removes the effect as soon as the source takes damage, for concentration-style effects broken by being hit.
Removes the effect when the target loses concealment. Used by effects that only make sense while hidden.
Keeps the effect on the unit after it leaves play, until the mission ends. Needed by effects that must still be read when the mission is scored.
Ticks regardless of whose turn it is. Normally an effect only ticks on its owner’s turn.
Only one target may carry this effect from a given source at a time; applying it elsewhere removes the earlier one.
Re-applying the effect increments a stack counter instead of simply refreshing its duration, so effects that grow with repetition can read the count.
When checking whether the target already has this effect, only consider copies from the same source. Lets several units apply their own instance.
A unit reduced to zero health while under this effect bleeds out instead of dying outright.
Whether the effect appears in the unit’s status UI at all. An effect with no FriendlyName set will show as blank.
Shows FriendlyName in the damage feedback as a distinct source, so its damage reads separately from the weapon’s.
As DisplayInUI, but for the unit that applied the effect rather than the one carrying it.
How many turns the effect lasts. Ignored when InfiniteDuration is true.
Percentage chance the effect is shed immediately on the first tick, before PerTurnShedChance takes over.
Percentage chance per tick that the effect wears off early. 0 means it only ends when its turns run out.
Precedence among effects of the same kind, used by auras so a stronger source wins over a weaker one.
Decides which effect controls the unit’s animation when several apply at once. The higher value wins.
Narrows the unit’s sight arc to this many degrees. When two effects both set it, the smaller arc applies.
Idle animation to play while the effect is active, taking over the unit’s normal idle.

families.name: ToHitCalc
families.intro: Edits the template's to-hit calculation. Two slots exist: `ToHitCalc` (`Template.AbilityToHitCalc`) and `ToHitOwnerOnMissCalc` (`Template.AbilityToHitOwnerOnMissCalc`), both taking a `ToHitCalcEdit` block. With `Class` **omitted**, the existing calc is edited **in place**; with `Class` set, the existing calc is edited in place when it is already exactly that class, otherwise it is **replaced** by a new instance (unset fields then take class defaults). Classes without a dedicated editor below (e.g. `X2AbilityToHitCalc_StandardMelee`, `X2AbilityToHitCalc_DeadEye`) are still valid `Class` values - they get the fields of their nearest listed ancestor.

families.name: Triggers
families.intro: Edits the `AbilityTriggers` array of the template. The trigger of class `Class` is edited **in place** if present; otherwise behaviour depends on `Mode`. **Caveat:** adding a *new* `X2AbilityTrigger_EventListener` from config is rarely useful - its `ListenerData.EventFn` delegate can only be assigned in code and stays `none`. Editing an existing listener trigger preserves its `EventFn`. `X2AbilityTrigger_OnAbilityActivated` is handled by the EventListener editor (its `MatchAbilityActivated` field is protected and cannot be set). See also `AbilityEventListenerEdits` in the template fields for the separate `Template.AbilityEventListeners` array.

fields.description: Order this trigger runs in relative to others on the same event. Lower runs first.
Event this listener waits for. The handling function can only be assigned in code, so a listener added purely from config never fires - editing an existing one does.
When the listener runs relative to the event being processed.
Which units the event is accepted from, such as only the source or only the target.
Order among listeners for the same event.
Method on the observer class that the trigger calls.
Class that observes the event. Loaded by name at runtime.
